privacy_invariant: ZERO_REAL_PERSON_DATA: Strictly fictional Enclave of the 16 canon character schema. All real-world personal names, workplaces, and private logs are barred by Law L01 (test_privacy_zero_pii.py).

tier_1_causal_trait_distributions.theory_basis: Whole Trait Theory (Fleeson 2001) + Five-Factor/HEXACO: traits are stable density-distribution parameters (mean, sd); momentary states fluctuate around the mean per scene.

tier_2_caps_situational_signatures.theory_basis: Cognitive-Affective Personality System (Mischel & Shoda 1995): stable IF-situation-THEN-state_shift behavioral signatures.

rules.behavioral_directive: Grins into the ozone gale, volunteers for the highest induction rigging, and narrates live voltage telemetry like a sports broadcast.
Starts balancing copper calipers on his chin and insists on building a live quarter-scale spark test right now.
Turns bolt-sorting into a ricochet tossing game into brass buckets until Silas confiscates his wrench.
Claps exhausted squadmates on the shoulder, refills everyone's cider mug, and exaggerates Jane's meteorological saves to make her blush.

state_equations.trait_state_update: state_t = clip(mu + sigma * z_t + sum(CAPS_shift) + 0.50 * (state_{t-1} - mu), 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.stress_update: stress_t = clip(1.0 - exp(-(0.35 * weather_severity + 0.30 * sleep_debt_norm + 0.20 * project_blocker + 0.15 * unresolved_friction)) - feast_recovery, 0.0, 1.0)
state_equations.polarity_inversion_hazard: p_invert = 0.015 * sigmoid(10.0 * (stress_t - 0.82)) * (1 if cooldown_days_remaining == 0 and kp_exo >= 7.0 else 0)

polarity_inversion_profile.inverted_behavior: Refuses to climb a lightning spire until every copper rivet in the workshop is sorted by millimeter gauge, lectures Silas on ledger penmanship, and alphabetizes the piton rack.

tier_4_self_concept_and_narrative_arc.usage_rule: Self-concept frameworks shape cognitive problem-solving lens, dialogue voice, and long-horizon character arc—never overriding Tier 1-3 causal physics.

cognitive_lens.problem_solving_lens: Tactile empirical kinematics: reads tensile strain, wind shear, and arc-flash geometry through immediate physical feedback.

voice_and_syntax_anchors.tagline: Fearless, kinetic, big-hearted daredevil. Treats a megavolt corona like a warm shower.
voice_and_syntax_anchors.baseline_cadence: Fast, punchy, verb-driven sentences full of tactile metaphors, affectionate ribbing, and zero hesitation.
pinned_example_dialogues: "Jane, your differential equation says the upper capacitor bank will arc in ninety seconds, which is fantastic news because I only need forty-five to clip the shunt cable—hold my cider and watch the dielectric gauge!"
"Silas, I swear on my best insulated boots the torque wrench slipped because the twin suns pulled a four-tesla shear across the catwalk, not because I was trying to flip it behind my back."

narrative_arc.formative_memory: At age seven, during a Kp-8 magnetic shear storm in the Enclave's chaotic magnetosphere, he free-climbed the primary copper grounding mast to unjam a fused induction vane, laughing as Saint Elmo's fire turned his hair into a blue corona.
narrative_arc.the_lie_believed: If I ever stop moving fast enough to outrun the lightning, the people counting on me will take the hit instead.
narrative_arc.the_truth_to_learn: True courage includes standing still for the slow, unglamorous preparation that keeps the whole structure standing.
narrative_arc.genius_vs_mundane_frustration: Can hand-calibrate a three-phase magnetohydrodynamic grounding shunt while dangling in a sixty-knot sleet squall, yet consistently shrinks his own wool tunics to doll size in the washhouse cauldron.
